data.name: Upin & Ipin Universe
data.detailed_description:
School’s out and the whole kampung is yours.

Step into the first-ever open-world adventure based on Upin & Ipin, the global animated phenomenon with billions of views on YouTube. Developed in collaboration between Les’ Copaque Production, the original creators of the beloved series, and Streamline Studios, this is the official game world of Kampung Durian Runtuh brought to life like never before.

Upin & Ipin Universe is a joyful, seamless open-world experience that captures the wonder of growing up in a Southeast Asian village where every bridge, trail, rooftop, and warung is crafted with authenticity by a team who lived it. In Malay, “kampung” means “village” and here, it means freedom, curiosity, and heart.

This is a world made for kids curious, playful, and free. In Upin & Ipin Universe, children are encouraged to explore on their own terms, discovering the kampung at their own pace. There are no instructions shouting what to do, no timers counting down. Just space to wander, wonder, and figure things out like childhood used to be.

Meet Upin & Ipin’s friends Mei Mei, Ehsan, Jarjit, Mail, and more each with their own personalities, quests, and playful challenges. Whether you’re helping Tok Dalang clean up or preparing food in Muthu’s warung, every interaction leads to new adventures and new memories.

Explore a lush, nostalgic world fully open from the start. Ride your bike through banana plantations. Stack boxes to reach rooftops. Climb jungle water towers, swim in rivers, and cross bamboo bridges to uncover firefly-lit hideouts, RC racetracks, and secret forest trails all waiting to be discovered by kids who follow their curiosity.

There are no locked zones. No load screens. No timers. Just the magic of childhood, rediscovered through play solo or side-by-side with a friend.

Key Features

A Fully Open World





Explore a handcrafted Southeast Asian village brought to life with:

  • Bustling markets, cozy homes, and animals in every yard

  • Jungle trails, rivers, treehouses, and farmland

  • Rooftop paths, secret shortcuts, and hand-built ramps

  • A full day-night cycle and dynamic weather system

You can reach anywhere from the beginning if you can find the way.

Play as Upin & Ipin

Control both twins in single-player, or team up in local co-op. Each has a unique personality, and your twin always follows you in solo play.

Main Quest: A Story With Heart

Help a mysterious visitor find his way home. Along the way, you'll uncover magical secrets, deepen your bond with the village, and relive the joys of growing up in a tight-knit community.

Things to Do

Farming

Plant and water crops. Attract butterflies and bees for better yields. Help Opah with her garden or grow your own. Use the produce for cooking (Masak-Masak).

 

Fishing

Choose your bait and location, then reel in local species. Some only appear at night or in the rain.

Critter Catching

Sneak through grass and shake trees to catch jungle insects. Use them to boost farming and fishing.

Cooking (Masak-Masak)

Prepare Malaysian dishes in a fast-paced rhythm minigame. Chop, fry, and serve to unlock new meals and story progress.

RC Car Racing

Drift through wild jungle courses. Compete in time trials and unlock new RC cars. Every day the race track changes shape. Then, take the Rc cars off the track and run them across them map!

Gasing Battles

Face off in spinning top arenas set up in gardens or even deep in the forest. Each top has stats, and every spin is a chance to win.

Exploring

Swim in rivers. Climb rooftops. Find secret tunnels. Ride bikes down ramps. Discover the mystery house in the jungle. The kampung is a kid’s dream world, ready to be explored.

A Living Kampung

  • Time & Weather: Quests, critters, and NPC routines change throughout the day. Rain, dusk, and morning each affect gameplay.

  • Offline-Only: No internet required. Everything is on the disc or download.

  • Safe for Families: No combat. No microtransactions. No fail states. Just play.

  • Built in Unreal Engine 5: Tuned for exploration, scalability and discovery.

Meet Your Friends in Kampung Durian Runtuh

You're never alone in Upin & Ipin Universe. The kampung is full of familiar faces, each with their own personalities, routines, and little stories to share. These aren’t just NPCs, they’re your friends, classmates, and neighbors. Many will offer you quests, unlock minigames, or simply brighten your day with a joke or a helping hand.

Here are just a few of the characters you'll get to know:

Kak Ros

Your loving (and slightly fierce) big sister. She keeps you in check and occasionally needs your help running errands or fixing something you broke.

Tok Dalang

The wise and mysterious village elder. He tells stories, hosts gasing battles, and just might know more about the jungle’s secrets than he lets on.

Mei Mei

Bright, creative, and full of energy. Mei Mei is often found in her garden or the kindergarten library, and she always has something interesting to do.

Ehsan

Your cheerful (and often hungry) classmate. Ehsan is full of ideas for games, snacks, and shortcuts around the kampung.

Jarjit Singh

The local poet and mischief-maker. Jarjit’s quests often involve rhymes, riddles, or unexpected surprises.

Mail

The savvy businessman of the group always looking for a trade, a deal, or a delivery run. Mail’s side quests tie into fishing, farming, and market trading.

Abang Iz

The friendly big brother figure in the kampung. He’s always working on something cool bikes, kites, or races and often pulls you into his ideas.

  

Frequently Asked Wonders (FAW)

Everything fans want to know right here.

Is the game fully voiced?

Yes! Upin & Ipin Universe features full voice acting in both English and Bahasa Malaysia, with every line recorded by professional voice talent.

You can choose your preferred audio language and subtitle language independently, so you can:

  • Play with Malaysian audio + English subtitles for full cultural authenticity

  • Switch to English voices + English text for young players or non-Malay speakers

  • Or mix and match however you like

This is a game built for the fans, new and old.

Can I run the game on a low-spec PC?

Absolutely. Upin & Ipin Universe includes a wide range of PC-focused optimization and graphics settings. Whether you're playing on a modern rig or a modest laptop, you'll be able to adjust:

  • Screen resolution

  • Texture quality

  • Shadow and lighting options

  • Post-processing levels

  • Frame rate limits

  • Input and controller remapping

Our goal is to make the game accessible and enjoyable for as many players as possible without sacrificing the spirit of the kampung.

 

 

I’ve never watched Upin & Ipin, can I still enjoy the game?

Absolutely. While fans of the animated series will feel right at home, Upin & Ipin Universe was intentionally designed to welcome new players from anywhere in the world.

At its core, this is a story about exploration, friendship, and community. Universal themes that speak to all ages and backgrounds. Whether you grew up in a kampung or have never heard the word before, the joy of discovery, helping others, and playing freely is something everyone can relate to.

You don’t need any prior knowledge, just a sense of curiosity and adventure.

 

 

 

This is more than a game, it’s a return to the joy of play, the freedom of childhood, and the heart of the kampung. Come explore, and make memories that feel like home.

data.short_description: Explore the vibrant world of Upin & Ipin Universe an open-world adventure inspired by kampung life, full of local charm, culture, and heartwarming stories from Malaysia.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Malay*, Spanish - Spain, Indonesian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Gtx 1060
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X, Intel Core i5-10600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700-XT 8GB/ Nvidia GeForce RTX 2060 12GB or Equivalent
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
